pages.text: Allah sent His Prophet Yunus (peace be upon him) to his people. He called them, but they did not believe. So he left them, angry, and boarded a ship full of passengers and goods.
Great waves surrounded the ship, and the passengers feared they would drown. They drew lots among themselves, and Yunus was cast into the sea, and the whale swallowed him.

Yunus was in the darkness of the night, the sea and the belly of the whale. He called out to his Lord, repenting: ﴿لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ﴾ — interpretation of the meaning: 'There is no god but You; glory be to You! I have been one of the wrongdoers.'
Allah answered him, saved him from his distress, and brought him out of the whale's belly onto an empty land. And Allah made a gourd plant grow over him to shade him.
